s: Nichum abelim ubiqqur cholim beshabbat ubo g' seipim: muttar lebaqqer cholim beshabbat. Velo yebaqqesh alehem rachamim kederek sheomerim bechol: "hammaqom yerachem veku'", sheal yede baqqashat rachamim yeorer beki veyitztaer, ella tzarik leharchib datam bedibre tanchumim shello yitztaaru beshabbat, sheyyomar: "shabbat hi millizoq urepua qeroba labo, verachamayv merubbim veshibtu beshalom". Veyesh omerim sheen tzerikin lomar: "verachamayv merubbim ku'". Veken nahagu. Veken hashsheliach tzibbur keshemmebarek hacholeh bebet hakkeneset veomer "mi shebberak ku'" — lo yomar: "hammaqom yishlach repua ku'", ella yomar: "shabbat hi millizoq urepua qeroba labo":
Umuttar lenachem abelim beshabbat. Umuttar lomar kederek sheomerim bechol: "hammaqom yenachemka", sheal yede baqqashato al nechamato lo yeorer beki:
Ubeqoshi hittiru lenachem abelim ulebaqqer cholim beshabbat, shemma yabo lehitztaer immahem, velo keotan sheen holekim kol yemot hashshabua raq beshabbat lebad:
